title: 18041 - 18041/P1633
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or connections faulty
stepByStepSolution: Have a look at the Pedal Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri assembly, not the Gaz Kelebeği Ünitesi.
Kontrol edin:  all connections between ECU and accelerator pedal - of course the pedal itself could be defective too.
technicalNotes: There are 2 sensors in the accelerator pedal, both measure the same except that they are working in opposite directions. This means one counts from 0 to 100, while the other one counts from 100 to 0.
